newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish bonds end down, off lows as others lead.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bonds end down, off lows as others lead.

text.p: 1545 GMT - Government bonds ended down on Monday, but off lows after paring losses in line with other European bond markets. * 10-yr 7.35 pct T-bond 108.40 vs 108.55, yield 6.16 vs 6.14 * Sept bond future 117.90 vs 118.01 at Friday's close (Background/details follow)
